findings.issue: Two setup harnesses outside the main suite still use the default local-superuser pools: 'OFS 0001-only upgrade guard' (:955-960) and the clean-DB migration test (:120-124). The clean test only runs DDL/catalog checks through admin, so nothing is lost there. The guard's 503 oracle can be met without the app role, but it does not prove that the typed error (rather than a raw 42501/42703) also comes out under FORCE RLS as stynx_app. This does not make any oracle impossible.
findings.required_change: Optional, in a later Inspector commit: bind `old-app`/`old-reader` with `asRole(..., 'stynx_app'|'stynx_reader')` in the 0001-only guard so the upgrade-required mapping is checked under the real app role.

summary: The blocking finding from review 4 is closed. The main suite now binds `app` and `reader` through `asRole` (:23-24, :36-39). It uses the same `&options=-c role=…` pattern as jobs actor-rls, which is valid because both forms of the helper URL already carry a query string (postgres.ts connectionString). A preflight at :46-62 asserts `{current_user:'stynx_app'|'stynx_reader', rolsuper:false, rolbypassrls:false}` on each pool. It runs right after moduleRef.init() and before the 0002 lookup (:87-88), so a red setup comes only from the missing 0002. 0001_roles creates both roles as NOBYPASSRLS. The data package has no RESET/DISCARD that would undo the startup role; only the migration runner, on the owner pool, does SET ROLE. The 0001 grants (ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA offline) cover the legacy tables. The probe table has explicit FORCE RLS plus a tenant policy and INSERT/SELECT grants to stynx_app. The applier keeps its `who:'stynx_app'` / `read committed` / tenant assertion (:660-667). The 40P01 is now a real SQLSTATE raised with `do $$ … raise exception … using errcode='40P01'` through the same `trx`, after the effect insert (:676-680). That puts the PostgreSQL transaction into the aborted state, and the oracles remain: item `received`, batch `open`/`responseStatus:null`, no consumption for the item, and no probe row for it (:759-802). The three repairs from review 3 are intact. (1) ctg9-http:202-235 still has unrelated batches `unrelated-a/b` with reservedNumber 1001/1002 and 201→422 `IDEMPOTENT_KEY_REUSE_DIFFERENT_BODY`, and the context-precedence test is unchanged. (2) The CTG9→E6 identity_mode test (:558-633) is unchanged. (3) The atomic test (:635-812) still has the shared trx via WeakMap plus `txid_current` equality between effect and event, sibling rollback, and exactly two event-port calls; retries of the deadlocked item stay consistent because each attempt rolls back. The E6 assertions on 0002 (second cancel 409, cross-key dedup, QUEUE_ID_REUSED) and the cross-tenant 404 remain, and none of them requires the superuser. Prompt 153 (:43-55) now states the real stynx_app pool without superuser/BYPASSRLS, `received` receipts outside the application tx, rollback of effect/consumption/receipt/event with the sibling `applied`, and exhausted 40P01/40001 → `received`/`open`/`responseStatus:null` with no consumption. It matches contract :302. I found no other impossible oracle. PASS releases the Inspector OFS commit and the integrated Engineer prompt-review. This review does not attest to the implementation, and neither Git nor the tests were run.
